notes.random: Each is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. These two were picked from the v4 finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, both years profitable) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. It shows they held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First noise-band look at the holdout. No noise-band strategy had been scored on 2025 onward before this run, and only these two, frozen beforehand, were run, so there's no selection among holdout results. The mean-reversion family was scored on ES 2025+ earlier (a different strategy), so the researcher has seen how that period treated mean reversion.
